title: Adulting With Cash: Personal Finance for Your Twenties

speaker.persona: Community college financial aid counselor running a free Saturday workshop; jokey, digressive, full of personal stories

outlineText:
Welcome and why money matters
Budgeting
  Track every dollar
  Needs, wants, savings split
Emergency fund [cues: rainy day]
Paying off debt
  Highest interest first
Credit scores
Investing basics
  Index funds [cues: S&P 500]
Retirement accounts
Avoiding scams
